top_findings: fersretirementcalculator.com does not resolve yet, so the site is not live or indexable.
Security headers are absent from the current build (HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy).
No named author or reviewer with credentials, which weakens E-E-A-T for finance-adjacent content.
The salary history textarea has no accessible name.
Several mobile tap targets are below the 44px recommended minimum.
quick_wins: Configure DNS, TLS, and security headers at the production host before launch.
Add an aria-label or associated label to the salary history textarea.
Increase vertical hit area for mobile navigation and FAQ summary rows.
Redirect trailing-slash variants such as /embed/ to their canonical paths.
Add a named author/reviewer and a proper Organization logo to strengthen E-E-A-T and schema.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt is present, allows all crawlers, and references the sitemap.
sitemap.xml is valid and includes the canonical homepage.
Canonical URLs are correct on both / and /embed.
Content is server-rendered in the HTML, so crawlers do not depend on JavaScript.
The /embed page is correctly noindex, nofollow.
No duplicate content or broken internal anchor links were found.

findings.title: Domain does not resolve
findings.description: fersretirementcalculator.com has no DNS A record, so HTTPS requests fail and the site is not live or crawlable.
findings.recommendation: Point DNS to the production host, provision a valid TLS certificate, and verify HTTPS before submitting to search engines.

findings.title: Security headers missing
findings.description: The response for / contains no HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy headers.
findings.recommendation: Add these headers at the CDN or hosting layer before launch. Astro preview intentionally omits them.

findings.title: Trailing slash on /embed returns 404
findings.description: GET /embed/ returns 404 while the canonical is /embed. A stray trailing slash can create crawl confusion and poor user experience.
findings.recommendation: Configure a 301 redirect from /embed/ to /embed at the host or add a redirect rule.

findings.title: No hreflang for a single-language page
findings.description: The page is English only and declares lang=en, but no hreflang/x-default annotations are present.
findings.recommendation: Optional unless additional language variants are introduced. Add x-default only if multilingual pages ship.

findings.title: Production caching not configured
findings.description: The local preview returns Cache-Control: no-cache for static files, which is expected for preview but not for production.
findings.recommendation: Enable immutable caching for hashed assets and a reasonable cache policy for HTML at the production host.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: The page contains about 21,000 characters of visible, original, topic-focused text.
OPM sources are cited, and the page includes editorial standards, a disclaimer, and a last-reviewed date.
FAQ answers cover real FERS rules with specific examples and formulas.
No thin or duplicate content was found on the two rendered pages.
Readability is strong: clear headings, tables, examples, and plain language.

findings.title: No named author or reviewer
findings.description: The schema and editorial copy attribute authorship to the Organization, not a person. For finance-adjacent content, named credentials improve trust and E-E-A-T.
findings.recommendation: Add a visible author/reviewer with relevant credentials and reference them from the TechArticle schema.

findings.title: Single page only
findings.description: The site currently consists of one indexable page. Topical authority and long-tail keyword coverage would benefit from supporting pages.
findings.recommendation: Add focused supporting pages for MRA+10, FERS Supplement, survivor benefits, CSRS, and military buyback with internal links back to the calculator.

findings.title: Review signal is date-only
findings.description: The page says it was reviewed against OPM guidance but does not name a reviewer or link to the review policy.
findings.recommendation: Name the reviewer and/or link to a methodology page to make the review claim more credible.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Title tag is keyword-front-loaded and within recommended length.
Meta description is unique, descriptive, and within recommended length.
Exactly one H1 exists and contains the target keyword.
Target keyword appears naturally in the H1, title, description, URL, and body.
Open Graph and Twitter card metadata are complete, including image dimensions and alt text.

findings.title: Very high H3 count
findings.description: The page contains 52 H3s alongside 23 H2s. This is not penalized, but several card and definition titles could be regular text or definition terms.
findings.recommendation: Review H3 usage and demote non-subsection card titles to paragraphs or dt elements where appropriate.

findings.title: No in-content imagery
findings.description: The page has zero body img elements, so there is no visual asset to reinforce the content or earn image-search traffic.
findings.recommendation: Add one or two explanatory diagrams or charts with descriptive alt text near the formula and timeline sections.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: A valid JSON-LD @graph is emitted on the homepage.
WebPage, BreadcrumbList, WebApplication, TechArticle, FAQPage, and Organization types are present.
FAQPage markup matches visible FAQ content.
WebApplication includes applicationCategory, featureList, and a free offer.
TechArticle includes author, publisher, datePublished, and dateModified.

findings.title: Organization logo uses favicon
findings.description: The Organization logo points to favicon.svg, which is not a proper organization logo asset.
findings.recommendation: Create a square, appropriately sized logo and reference it in the Organization schema.

findings.title: No person-level author
findings.description: TechArticle uses an Organization author. A person-level author or reviewer would improve E-E-A-T and schema richness.
findings.recommendation: Add a Person node for the author/reviewer and reference it from the article.

findings.title: WebApplication browser requirement wording
findings.description: browserRequirements says Requires JavaScript, but the server-rendered page and default estimate work without JavaScript. The interactive calculator does require JavaScript.
findings.recommendation: Clarify that the static content is server-rendered while the interactive calculation requires JavaScript.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Lighthouse on the production preview scores performance 100.
Measured LCP is 400ms locally; FCP is 400ms; CLS is near zero.
TTFB is 61ms and full load is about 554ms on the local preview.
The page is very light: four resources and roughly 193KB total transfer.
No render-blocking third-party scripts or oversized images were found.

findings.title: Dev server metrics are not production
findings.description: Lighthouse against the dev server showed FCP/LCP above 5s due to Vite on-demand compilation, but the static preview is fast.
findings.recommendation: Monitor Core Web Vitals with field data after launch rather than relying on local dev-server runs.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: llms.txt is present and lists the calculator and all major sections with production URLs.
Content is fully server-rendered, so AI crawlers can read it without JavaScript.
robots.txt allows AI crawlers.
Clear editorial standards, sources, and limitations make the content easy to cite.
Headings, FAQ, and tables are well structured for extraction.

findings.title: Thin authority signals for AI citation
findings.description: The page has an Organization author but no named person, social links, or external authority references beyond OPM.
findings.recommendation: Add a named author/reviewer, organization sameAs links, and a concise methodology section to improve citability.

findings.title: No full-content llms.txt variant
findings.description: The llms.txt is a section index rather than a full machine-readable text dump.
findings.recommendation: Optionally add llms-full.txt with the full FAQ and editorial text once the site is live.

categories.name: Images
what_works: A 1200x630 OG image exists with correct Open Graph dimensions, type, and alt text.
No broken img elements were found.
The OG image is 89KB, which is reasonable for a social preview.

findings.title: No in-content images
findings.description: The homepage has zero body images, so it lacks visual reinforcement for formula explanations and timelines.
findings.recommendation: Add a small number of relevant diagrams or charts with descriptive alt text and width/height attributes.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Configure DNS for fersretirementcalculator.com and provision HTTPS.
Add security headers at the production host/CDN.
Verify robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, and OG assets resolve over HTTPS.

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add a named author/reviewer with credentials and update schema.
Add an accessible name to the salary history textarea.
Increase mobile tap targets for navigation and FAQ rows.
Replace the Organization favicon logo with a proper logo asset.

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Publish supporting pages for MRA+10, FERS Supplement, survivor benefits, CSRS, and military buyback.
Add one or two explanatory diagrams to the homepage.
Add llms-full.txt and an editorial/methodology page.

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Submit the sitemap in Search Console and monitor indexation.
Track Core Web Vitals field data after launch.
Review crawl stats, impressions, and positions monthly.
Rebuild the audit baseline after the first production deploy.
